sentence_1_en: Speaking with reporters in Montreal, Canada, Walesa says the change of leadership in East Germany came about because the old guard leaders missed the train of history.

sentence_3_it: Nell'antica Roma, le guardie del corpo che circondavano i ricchi e potenti per tutelarli quando camminavano per le strade, erano chiamate satelliti.
sentence_3_en: In ancient Rome, the bodyguards who surrounded the wealthy and powerful to protect them when they walked the streets, were called satellites.
